_comment: Written exceptions to the Classic/Rustic engine freeze (policy 2026-07-25). Each entry authorizes ONE reviewed byte-state of ONE path: the next edit to an authorized file fails again until it is re-authorized. Entries are added only by `engine-freeze-gate.mjs --authorize <path> --reason "<text>"`; there is no bulk snapshot mode, and generated files are never authorizable.
policy: Classic/Rustic are read-only; implementation effort is exclusively Modern. Every difference between baseRevision and the worktree under engines/classic or engines/rustic — committed history included — must be listed here with a matching content pin.

WO-CAN-04 / F-18 determinism: the tooltip id was allocated with a random suffix inside useRef, so the server and the client produced different values for an aria-describedby target and every hydration mismatched. Replaced by React useId(), which is the same allocator the modern sibling already uses (classic allocates no id of its own). This is a correctness fix demanded by a cross-cutting blocking gate (component-determinism-gate, closure criterion of F-18: zero occurrences under src/components), not engine content work: no token, no style, no anatomy and no accessibility affordance moved.

packages/core/src/foundation/tokens/css/.reason: WO-CAN-06 one-anatomy-truth (F-29): this file is a prose SUPPORT MANIFEST with zero runtime consumers -- its only readers are anatomy-variant-gate and that gate's self-test -- and it claimed 'supported'/'approximated' for all ten rows while the classic theme adapter declares chrome.anatomy 'unsupported' and admission refuses by name any tenant that would select a variant. CI was validating a document the runtime contradicts. All ten support values are set to the adapter's truth; every original Ant-wrapper sentence is preserved verbatim as supplierNote, so no evidence is destroyed. No Classic implementation, skin, token, test or a11y work was added, removed or improved: the classic surface stamps no data-anatomy-* attribute and accepts no anatomy prop before or after this edit.
